sections.title: Overview
content: SignalScope is a Schwung tool for Ableton Move with CPU temperature, CPU use, memory, process, WiFi, network, storage, and uptime views.
It also includes an optional orchestra mode that turns nearby WiFi networks or active processes into pitched voices.

sections.title: Navigation
content: Play performs a one-shot refresh for the current tab. On WiFi and ORCH it also rescans.

sections.title: Monitoring
content: Rec toggles auto refresh on and off.
The PROC tab reports the top CPU consumers, including the main Move host process when it is dominant.
Refresh actions speak the new values for the current tab.

sections.title: Orchestra
content: Step 1 selects WiFi source, Step 2 selects Process source, Step 3 refreshes and scans, Step 4 toggles orchestra on and off.
Knob 1 selects waveform, Knob 2 sets key, Knob 3 sets repeat rate, Knob 4 sets decay, Knobs 5 to 8 control pan for voices 1 to 4.
Track buttons select scale: Track 1 Major 7, Track 2 Minor 7, Track 3 Suspended 7, Track 4 Pentatonic.
